name: woiii-me
description: Finds the best pressing of a record on Discogs, for sound or for collectors, with the evidence behind each score. Read-only, no prices. Data provided by Discogs; not affiliated with Discogs.

interface.longDescription:
WOIII.me finds the best pressing of a record on Discogs, for sound or for collectors, and shows the evidence behind each score: mastering engineers, matrix and runout stampers, pressing plants, label reputation, format, community ratings and demand.

Ask about one pressing (paste a Discogs release link), survey an album's pressings, compare the ones you are deciding between, or rank your own wantlist by how well each album fits your collection. Open the WOIII.me home for the same workflows on one page.

Open an artist's page to read the discography for gaps: what you own, what you want, and the five records that matter most. Set collecting goals (complete an artist, own one of WOIII.me's canons), get goal suggestions from your own shelf, and pick something to play from your collection by mood.

Read-only: WOIII.me never changes anything on Discogs, and it shows no prices or cover images. Scores read Discogs data; they do not measure sound. Data provided by Discogs; WOIII.me is not affiliated with Discogs.
defaultPrompt: Is this a good pressing? <paste a Discogs release link>
What's the best-sounding pressing of Kind of Blue?
Which albums on my wantlist should I buy first?
